title: TCS New York City Marathon — Transportation to the Start
claims: The Staten Island Ferry departs Whitehall Terminal in Manhattan, with an estimated total travel time of 90 minutes.
Whitehall Terminal is accessible by the 1 train at South Ferry, the R and W trains at Whitehall Street–South Ferry, and the M15, M20 and M55 buses.
The Staten Island Ferry is free and carries runners to St. George Terminal, from which free buses transport runners to Fort Wadsworth.

The Midtown Manhattan bus departs the New York Public Library at Fifth Avenue and 40th Street, with an estimated total travel time of 90 minutes and a requirement to arrive 15 minutes before departure; buses go directly to Fort Wadsworth.
The New Jersey bus departs MetLife Stadium Parking Lot K, with an estimated travel time of 60 minutes and a requirement to arrive 15 minutes before departure; buses go directly to Fort Wadsworth.
Runners expecting a finish time of four hours or more are recommended to take the Staten Island Ferry because it arrives closer to their wave start time.
Private car, taxi and rideshare drop-off is only at McClean Avenue and Ocean Avenue on Staten Island; private bus drop-off is near McClean Avenue and Lily Pond Avenue.
There is no parking at the start, and the walk from the drop-off area to the start villages is approximately half a mile.
The Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge closes to all traffic at 7:00 a.m., and private vehicles must arrive at the start before that time.
Before 7:00 a.m., private vehicles from New Jersey may use Exit 14 (Narrows Road North / Hylan Boulevard); after 7:00 a.m., closures require the Clove Road exit.
Transportation selection opened on 25 August and closed on 8 September at 11:59 p.m. ET.
New in 2026, runners select their mode of transport and NYRR assigns a departure time based on registered or best pace.

Everyone must arrive during their assigned transportation time slot and use their selected mode; using the Staten Island Ferry, NYPL bus or New Jersey bus without that assignment may lead to a warning, disqualification, cancellation of purchased entries or suspension.
Team for Climate runners are automatically assigned to the 6:15 a.m. Staten Island Ferry option, in line with their wave and corral, but may change it during the selection window.
Fred's Team buses depart West 48th Street and Broadway at 5:45 a.m., and Silver Level Charity Partner buses depart 59th Street/Central Park South and Seventh Avenue at 5:45 a.m.
International Tour Operators may use official NYRR transport, including the ITO Westside Midtown Ferry, or charter coaches from hotels to Fort Wadsworth.
The organiser recommends checking mta.info for planned service changes on the subway, bus, Long Island Railroad and Metro-North.
